# Incogniton automation examples

> Official, runnable examples for automating the Incogniton antidetect browser with Playwright, Puppeteer (Node.js/TypeScript) and Playwright/Selenium (Python) through the local Incogniton API and the official SDKs (`incogniton` on npm and PyPI).

Key facts: the Incogniton desktop app must be running and logged in (Windows/macOS); the API listens on 127.0.0.1:35000. Launch with the SDK, connect over CDP, and use the profile's default context (`browser.contexts()[0]`) for persistent cookies/storage. Stop with CDP `Browser.close` and wait for status `Ready`; `profile.stop()` terminates the browser process.

## Examples

- [Fill and submit a form in an Incogniton profile with Playwright](https://github.com/WorkingGreen/incogniton-automation-examples/blob/main/docs/examples/click-and-fill-form.md): How do I click buttons and fill forms in an Incogniton profile?
- [Keep cookies, localStorage and IndexedDB between Incogniton automation runs](https://github.com/WorkingGreen/incogniton-automation-examples/blob/main/docs/examples/reuse-profile-session.md): How do I preserve cookies and localStorage in Incogniton automation?
- [Automate same-origin and cross-origin iframes in Incogniton with Playwright](https://github.com/WorkingGreen/incogniton-automation-examples/blob/main/docs/examples/interact-with-iframe.md): How do I automate an iframe in an Incogniton profile?
- [Control a canvas game with keyboard and mouse in Incogniton (Playwright)](https://github.com/WorkingGreen/incogniton-automation-examples/blob/main/docs/examples/control-canvas-game.md): How do I automate a canvas game in an Incogniton profile?
- [Run multiple Incogniton profiles concurrently with Playwright](https://github.com/WorkingGreen/incogniton-automation-examples/blob/main/docs/examples/run-multiple-profiles.md): How do I run multiple Incogniton profiles concurrently?
- [Attach Playwright to an Incogniton profile that is already running](https://github.com/WorkingGreen/incogniton-automation-examples/blob/main/docs/examples/attach-to-running-profile.md): How do I connect to an existing Incogniton profile without restarting it?
- [Create and delete a temporary Incogniton profile with the Node.js SDK](https://github.com/WorkingGreen/incogniton-automation-examples/blob/main/docs/examples/create-and-clean-up-profile.md): How do I create an Incogniton profile from code?
- [Extract a paginated table to JSON in an Incogniton profile](https://github.com/WorkingGreen/incogniton-automation-examples/blob/main/docs/examples/extract-paginated-data.md): How do I scrape a paginated table with Playwright in Incogniton?
- [Upload and download files in an Incogniton profile with Playwright](https://github.com/WorkingGreen/incogniton-automation-examples/blob/main/docs/examples/upload-and-download-files.md): How do I upload and download files with Playwright in Incogniton?
- [Mock and block network requests in an Incogniton profile with Playwright](https://github.com/WorkingGreen/incogniton-automation-examples/blob/main/docs/examples/intercept-network-requests.md): How do I intercept or mock network requests in Incogniton automation?
- [Launch an Incogniton profile with Puppeteer and take a screenshot](https://github.com/WorkingGreen/incogniton-automation-examples/blob/main/docs/examples/puppeteer-launch-profile-and-screenshot.md): How do I automate Incogniton with Puppeteer?

- [Take screenshots with the Incogniton Python SDK and Playwright](https://github.com/WorkingGreen/incogniton-automation-examples/blob/main/docs/examples/python-playwright-launch-profile-and-screenshot.md): How do I take screenshots using the Incogniton Python SDK?
